title: 上方カメラ式ブックスキャナー
description: 図書館や資料デジタル化室の机上に置くブックスキャナー。空の左右傾斜ブッククレードル、下側支え/蝶番、後柱と前に張り出すカメラアーム、下向きレンズ外形、左右の固定照明バー、操作面と曲線ケーブルを造形しています。本・紙面画像は付属せず一式1点。レンズ/画面/拡散板は不透明で、照明発光・撮影・スキャン・クレードル調整は実装していません。台の高さに合わせて配置してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.634 × 0.919 × 0.507 m、5,504三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An overhead book scanner for library and digitization-room desks. It includes an empty pair of inclined cradle wings, underside braces/hinges, rear column/forward camera arm, downward lens exterior, fixed side light bars, controls and curved cable. No book or page image is included; the assembly counts once. Lens, screen and diffusers are opaque, with no illumination, capture, scanning or cradle adjustment implemented. Adjust placement to desk height. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.634 × 0.919 × 0.507 m; 5,504 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
